name: Washed Heavyweight Tee
description: 280 gsm cotton jersey, garment washed with raw edge accents. Heavy drape, softened concrete texture, built to wear in and wear out.

name: Concrete Zip Hoodie
description: Custom milled 480 gsm heavyweight brushed loopback fleece. Boxy drop-shoulder cut, dual two-way industrial zipper, distressed ribbing.

name: Raw Edge Oversized Tee
description: Unhemmed collar and cuffs with an exaggerated dropped shoulder silhouette. Pigment dyed and silicon washed for a lived-in stone finish.

name: Distressed Utility Jacket
description: Stone-washed duck canvas shell featuring quad gusset cargo pockets, heavy gauge metal snap closures, and reinforced elbow paneling.

name: Black Leather Biker Jacket
description: Premium 1.2mm full-grain cowhide leather with matte black finish. Asymmetrical front zip, heavy-gauge belted hem, and zippered gusset cuffs.

name: Black Leather Bomber Jacket
description: Subtle grain washed black nappa leather shell with thick ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem. Utility flight sleeve pocket and custom puller.
